clue.text: Becky regarded as wide-awake

parts.note: Becky Sharp is the scheming heroine of Thackeray's novel Vanity Fair
regarded means looked at, eyed

explanation.surface: Someone called Becky is thought of as alert and on the ball.
explanation.walkthrough: Becky Sharp is the heroine of Thackeray's Vanity Fair, a classic English novel.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone with keen vision misses nothing, so the compound is an idiom for alert and observant.

clue.text: As fraud, for example, develops, protection is needed

indicators.note: a thing that develops changes its form, so these letters take a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Wherever fraud of this kind takes hold, people need some defence against it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'develops' rearranges ASFRAUD together with EG into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: A protective measure or guarantee against harm is a synonym for protection.

clue.text: Lake under a high point

indicators.note: in a down clue the piece placed under another comes after it

parts.note: Lake Erie is one of the North American Great Lakes

explanation.surface: A lake sits below a mountain peak.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down clue 'under' puts ERIE beneath A, so after it.
explanation.definitionFit: An eagle's nest is built on a crag or tall tree, a lofty eyrie, so it is a high perch.

clue.text: Foresight shown in nominating her

explanation.surface: Careful forethought went into choosing her for the post.
explanation.walkthrough: The second reading takes 'nominating' as naming: this woman's name is the very word for foresight.
explanation.definitionFit: Prudence means wise caution looking ahead, and it is also a girl's first name, so naming her says it.

clue.text: Longing to be making money after it's almost all gone

indicators.note: the earnings piece is placed after the leftover letter
once nearly every letter of the word money has gone, only its last letter remains

parts.note: making, as in making a living, means earning

explanation.surface: A craving for income that sets in once your savings have nearly run out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'it's almost all gone' strips MONE from 'money', leaving Y; 'after' puts EARNING (making, as in making a salary) behind it.
explanation.definitionFit: Yearning is a strong wish or desire for something, a synonym for longing.

clue.text: Decry County support for Party

indicators.note: in a down clue a supporting piece goes underneath, so it comes second

parts.note: a do is an informal word for a party
Down is a county of Northern Ireland

explanation.surface: Disparaging a county that backs a political party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'support for' sets DOWN beneath DO in this down clue. Down is a county in Northern Ireland.
explanation.definitionFit: To do someone down is an idiom for belittling or criticising them.

clue.text: Saw a race in low gear…

indicators.note: the race is placed inside the cow's noise

parts.note: a cow lows, its call is a moo
the TT is the Tourist Trophy motorcycle race on the Isle of Man

explanation.surface: Watching a car race run at crawling speed in first gear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'low' looks like it goes with 'gear', but here it is a cow's call. The TT is the Isle of Man motorcycle race. 'gear' and the ellipsis just carry the motoring picture on into 9 across.
explanation.definitionFit: A saw is an old saying or maxim, the same as a motto.

clue.text: Once upon a time perhaps

parts.note: a word that once, in older English, served to mean perhaps

explanation.definitionFit: The archaic adverb meant maybe, so it is how perhaps was said in times gone by.

clue.text: Pilgrim on the stage

explanation.surface: A pilgrim appearing in a theatrical production.
explanation.walkthrough: 'stage' is not the theatre but the stagecoach: a person on the stage is a passenger making a journey.
explanation.definitionFit: A pilgrim is one who journeys to a shrine, and a stagecoach passenger is likewise one making a journey.

clue.text: Group of the month, and French

parts.note: Oct. abbreviates October, a month
et is French for and

explanation.surface: A gathering of the month's people, with some French among them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'and French' means the French word for and, ET.
explanation.definitionFit: A set of eight performers or things is a group of a particular size.

clue.text: . .the category of the cars is given here as a rule

explanation.surface: The class the racing cars fall into is laid down as a regulation.
explanation.walkthrough: Racing cars are classed as Formula One, Formula Two and so on; the ellipsis carries on the motor-racing picture from 6 across.
explanation.definitionFit: A class of racing car is called by this term, and a set method or prescribed recipe is a rule.

clue.text: Used to cure thirsty sea-dog

parts.note: thirsty means dry
an old salt is a veteran sailor, a sea-dog

explanation.surface: A parched old sailor, once used to cure something.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Used to' only joins: the definition is the verb cure, to preserve meat or fish.
explanation.definitionFit: To preserve meat by salting and drying it is to cure it.

clue.text: See for example flying birds

indicators.note: letters sent flying are scattered and land in a new arrangement

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Look at those birds in flight, for instance.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flying' rearranges SEE and EG.
explanation.definitionFit: These are large waterfowl, a kind of bird.

clue.text: Prime mover in the daily round

definitions.text: Prime mover in the daily round

parts.words: Prime mover in the daily round
parts.note: the daily round is a paper round, and this shopkeeper is the one who sends the papers out

explanation.definitionFit: The shopkeeper who sells papers organises the morning delivery round, so is its chief mover.

clue.text: These days by consent in Bonn foreign money is near the mark

parts.note: AD, anno Domini, labels the present era
ja is German for yes; Bonn was West Germany's capital
a cent is a coin of many foreign currencies

explanation.surface: Nowadays, by agreement in Germany, foreign currency comes close to the Deutschmark.
explanation.walkthrough: 'the mark' looks like the German currency, but it belongs to the definition: lying close to a mark or line.
explanation.definitionFit: Adjacent means lying beside or next to, so it is close by a given point.

clue.text: Reckless activity of girl on horseback, say

parts.note: Joy is a girl's name
on horseback describes riding

explanation.surface: A girl galloping wildly on her horse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'say' marks that a girl named Joy on a horse is only a playful reading of the word.
explanation.definitionFit: Joyriding is driving a stolen car recklessly for thrills, an irresponsible pastime.

clue.text: This is a piece of evidence

definitions.text: This is a piece of evidence

parts.words: This is a piece of evidence
parts.note: a fact that helps a detective, and also the line the solver is reading now

explanation.definitionFit: A hint pointing towards solving a crime is a piece of evidence, and the word also names a crossword prompt.

clue.text: Constantly tip under a pound a year

parts.note: a tip is an end
under, as in under a figure, means less
L, from Latin libra, is the pound sign

explanation.surface: Always leaving a tip of less than a pound each year.
explanation.walkthrough: 'under' is a piece, not a placing signal: less than, LESS.
explanation.definitionFit: Going on without stopping or limit is a synonym for continually.

clue.text: The chap for old-time transport

explanation.surface: The man who arranges vintage travel.
explanation.walkthrough: The chap is a man's name; the other sense is a four-wheeled closed horse carriage of the 19th century.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a boy's name, and also an old enclosed horse-drawn carriage, a vehicle of bygone days.

clue.text: Destitute as a result of being away more?

definitions.text: Destitute as a result of being away more?

parts.words: Destitute as a result of being away more?
parts.note: being away is not being at your house; more away means having less of a house

explanation.definitionFit: Lacking any dwelling marks one as utterly poor, and the phrase splits into a house and less.

clue.text: Robinson's man was one of these

definitions.text: Robinson's man was one of these

parts.words: Robinson's man was one of these
parts.note: Robinson Crusoe's servant was called Friday, a weekday

explanation.definitionFit: Friday, Crusoe's companion, is named after one of the seven periods of the week.

clue.text: Colourful family rebel

parts.note: blood means kin or family, as in blood relations
a red is a revolutionary, a rebel

explanation.surface: A family's rebel is a vivid character.
explanation.definitionFit: A deep crimson shade is decidedly vivid in hue.

clue.text: Snakes cut to pieces by knives

indicators.note: something cut to pieces falls apart, so these letters reassemble in another order

explanation.surface: Serpents chopped up with blades.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cut to pieces' rearranges SNAKES. A skean is an old Irish or Highland dagger.
explanation.definitionFit: A skean (as in skean-dhu) is a dagger, so the plural is a set of blades.

clue.text: Such an Arab is 18

parts.note: an old phrase for a vagrant child of the slums, who has no roof, the answer to 18 down

explanation.definitionFit: A street Arab is a dated term for a homeless urchin, which links it to the destitute of 18.

clue.text: Grace, for example, shown in game by royalty

indicators.note: royalty is placed alongside the game

parts.note: cricket is a bat-and-ball game
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the Queen

explanation.surface: Gracefulness on display in a sport played before royalty.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Grace' is W. G. Grace, the great Victorian English cricketer, not elegance. ER = Elizabeth Regina, the Queen.
explanation.definitionFit: W. G. Grace was a celebrated Victorian batsman, an example of a player of that sport.

clue.text: Fascination of an amulet

explanation.surface: The allure of a lucky talisman.
explanation.definitionFit: Charm means attractive power, and it is also a trinket worn to ward off evil or bring luck.

clue.text: Run away with the Spanish Open almost

parts.note: el is Spanish for the

indicators.note: almost the whole word, so its last letter is dropped

explanation.surface: Pulling out of the Spanish Open golf tournament just before finishing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' drops the last letter of OPEN, giving OPE.
explanation.definitionFit: To elope is to run off secretly with a lover to marry.

clue.text: Floor lopsided including lower deck

indicators.note: the words floor lopsided contain the answer run within them

explanation.surface: A floor that slopes, and that includes the bottom level of a ship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'including' marks the answer sitting inside 'Floor lopsided'.
explanation.definitionFit: The orlop is the lowest deck of a sailing ship.

clue.text: Rouse team in a reshuffle

indicators.note: a cabinet reshuffle moves people around, so these letters change places

explanation.surface: A manager stirs the team up by rearranging the players.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in a reshuffle' looks like a link plus indicator, but 'in a' is fodder: TEAMINA rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: To animate is to stir into life, enliven, which is what rouse means.

clue.text: Indicators almost superfluous

indicators.note: almost the whole word, so the final letter is dropped

parts.note: superfluous means unnecessary, needless

explanation.surface: Signs that are nearly surplus to requirements.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' trims the last S from NEEDLESS.
explanation.definitionFit: The pointers on dials and gauges are instruments' indicators.

clue.text: One who was wise to follow a star

definitions.text: One who was wise to follow a star

parts.words: One who was wise to follow a star
parts.note: the Wise Men of the Nativity followed the star of Bethlehem

explanation.definitionFit: A magus is one of the three Wise Men who followed the Bethlehem star.

clue.text: Boy and girl given to esoteric thought

parts.note: Theo is a boy's name
Sophy is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A boy and a girl who are drawn to mystical ideas.
explanation.definitionFit: Theosophy is a mystical philosophy claiming insight into the divine, a body of occult doctrine.
